metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature around Arc de Triomphe at least 5 degress Celsius hotter than the Palace and Park of Versailles on August 6, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need land surface temperature (LST) for two Paris‐area locations on the same day, 6 August 2024. Best single-day LST in GEE: MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (1 km, daily). If that collection returns 0 images (unlikely but possible on same-day query), we’ll print C1. Landsat ST can resolve finer spatial differences but may arrive several days later; we’ll avoid it unless MODIS is missing. 2. Masking: MOD11A1 has mandatory QC flags; mask out pixels with QC≠0 (i.e., keep only “good” LST). We do not mask clouds (QC already factors them in) and the question never asks about cloud cover. 3. Logic: - Compute mean LST inside a 1-km buffer around each POI on 2024-08-06. - If one collection or the other ends up with 0 images, print C1. - After QC masking, any buffer that yields zero valid pixels triggers C2. - If either mean value is None/NaN, print C3. - Otherwise compare Arc-de-Triomphe mean vs Versailles mean; if diff ≥ 5 °C → “A”, else “B”. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Date arc = ee.Geometry.Point([2.2950, 48.8738]).buffer(1000) # Arc de Triomphe vers = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1204, 48.8055]).buffer(1000) # Palace of Versailles date = '2024-08-06' # 2. Acquire MODIS LST lst = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, date) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])) if lst.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS LST image for 2024-08-06.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Mask bad QC & reduce img = lst.first() qa = img.select('QC_Day') mask = qa.eq(0) # keep only “good” pixels lst_qc= img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # scale → °C countArc = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=arc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() countVers = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=vers, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if countArc==0 or countVers==0: print("No valid pixels after QC masking.") print("C2") exit() meanArc = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=arc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() meanVers = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=vers, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if meanArc is None or meanVers is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") exit() diff = meanArc - meanVers print(f"Arc LST: {meanArc:.2f}°C, Versailles LST: {meanVers:.2f}°C, Diff: {diff:.2f}°C, Pixels: {int(countArc)}/{int(countVers)}") print("A" if diff >= 5 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Date
arc   = ee.Geometry.Point([2.2950, 48.8738]).buffer(1000)  # Arc de Triomphe
vers  = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1204, 48.8055]).buffer(1000)  # Palace of Versailles
date  = '2024-08-06'

# 2. Acquire MODIS LST
lst = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
         .filterDate(date, date)
         .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']))

if lst.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS LST image for 2024-08-06.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Mask bad QC & reduce
img   = lst.first()
qa    = img.select('QC_Day')
mask  = qa.eq(0)                         # keep only “good” pixels
lst_qc= img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # scale → °C

countArc  = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=arc,  scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
countVers = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=vers, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if countArc==0 or countVers==0:
    print("No valid pixels after QC masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

meanArc  = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=arc,  scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
meanVers = lst_qc.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=vers, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

if meanArc is None or meanVers is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

diff = meanArc - meanVers
print(f"Arc LST: {meanArc:.2f}°C, Versailles LST: {meanVers:.2f}°C, Diff: {diff:.2f}°C, Pixels: {int(countArc)}/{int(countVers)}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if diff >= 5 else "<answer>B</answer>")
